scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance for Saving in Consumption of Energy and Water
other_conditions: Eligible units include both existing and new industrial units.
Units must implement actions to reduce energy or water consumption.
A minimum 10% reduction in energy or water consumption over the previous 12 months is required to qualify for equipment cost assistance.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹50,000 reimbursement for an energy/water audit (75% of cost) and up to ₹20,00,000 assistance for recommended equipment (25% of cost).
